response:
It sounds like you are carrying an incredibly heavy emotional load. Experiencing intense physical reactions to past memories, feeling overwhelmed in loud environments, and carrying a deep fear of abandonment can be exhausting. When your body reacts by pulling your hair or hitting yourself, it shows just how much pain and distress you are trying to manage in those moments. 

Because you are hurting yourself when these feelings peak, please consider reaching out for immediate support. You can text HOME to 741741 to connect with the Crisis Text Line, or call or text 988 (in the US and Canada) to speak with someone who can help you navigate these overwhelming moments safely. A mental health professional could also be incredibly helpful in exploring these sensory sensitivities and relationship fears, giving you gentler ways to cope so you don't have to carry this all on your own.
